name: Huntsman Against Darkness
storyline:
The Huntsman left his village at dawn for what should have been another ordinary hunt. When he returned, silence had replaced laughter.

Homes lay in ruins. The streets were stained by the aftermath of battle. The villagers had vanished, taken by an endless tide of corrupted creatures that emerged from the darkness. Among them were his own family.

With nothing left to lose, the Huntsman swore that no innocent soul would remain imprisoned by evil.

Fight through relentless hordes of monstrous enemies, rescue your family and neighbors, and gather the resources needed to rebuild the village they tried to erase. Every battle strengthens your resolve. Every rescued survivor restores hope. Every rebuilt structure brings life back to a land consumed by darkness.

Justice is your purpose.

Vengeance is your fuel.

The hunt has begun.
summary: A dark roguelite action experience where you fight through endless hordes of corrupted creatures, free your family and rebuild the village. Survive brutal arena battles, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat massive bosses, and rebuild a fallen medieval village one run at a time.
